title: Ngā Wairua o te Āwhata
intro: Ka hoki whakamuri koe ki tētahi wā i tono ai tētahi rangatira nanakia kia tino piripono ki ngā atua teka. I whakakahore tētahi hapori iti o ngā wairua pono, ā, i pāngia e tētahi whiu tino kino, ā, ka kanga tonutia. Kei roto i te Quran tō rātou kōrero hei tohu mō te whakapono pumau. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei rōpū pumau?
clues: I noho mātou i tētahi whenua i raro i te mana o tētahi rangatira i tono kia karakia ki ngā atua teka
I pāngia tō mātou hapori e te whakatoi nui nā tō mātou whakapono ki a Allah anake
I whakahau te rangatira kia keria he awaawa nui, kia tahuna hoki ki te ahi mura.
Nā te mea i whakakahore mātou ki te whakarērea tō mātou whakapono, i makahia mātou ki roto i taua poka mura, takitahi
I uru tō mātou kōrero ki roto i te Quran, ā, ko te hunga i whakatoi i a mātou i kanga tonutia.
Ko te ingoa o te sura e tuhi ana i tō tātou whakamātautau i ahu mai i ngā tohu nui o te rangi

identity.label: Ko wai tātou?
options: Ngā Hoa o te Parekura (Ashab al-Ukhdud)
Ngā tāngata o te ana (Ashab al-Kahf)
Ngā tāngata o te Hāpati
Te iwi o Āta
Te iwi o Thamud
identity.answer: Ngā Hoa o te Parekura (Ashab al-Ukhdud)

trial.label: Tā Mātou Whakamātautau
options: Te tahuna ora i roto i te poka mura
Te hiri i roto i te ana mō ngā tau maha
Te hī ika i te rā tapu o te okiokinga
E whakangaromia ana e te hau e pupuhi ana
Te patu i tētahi kamera uwha tapu
trial.answer: Te tahuna ora i roto i te poka mura

location.label: Te Huānga Matua
options: He awaawa ahi e mura ana
He ana huna me te kurī pono
Ngā pou teitei o tētahi tāone tawhito kua whakangaromia
Ngā whare maunga i whakairohia ki ngā pari kohatu
He mania tuwhera e pupuhihia ana e ngā hau kaha
location.answer: He awaawa ahi e mura ana

outcome.label: Tā Mātou Hua
options: I whakamatea mātou, ā, i kanga tonutia ngā kaitukino
I ara ake mātou i muri i te moe mō ngā tau 309
I hurihia mātou hei makimaki mō ā mātou hara
I whakangaromia mātou katoa e te hau nui e aue ana
Kotahi te tangi whakangaro i pakaru ai tō mātou oranga
outcome.answer: I whakamatea mātou, ā, i kanga tonutia ngā kaitukino

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
